Pose review

Every reference pose as the app draws it now, from three sides: the view the app opens with, a second view along the mat, and a three-quarter view between them, with the pose’s alignment rules measured on the reference. Click any figure to drag its joints. Mark each one Looks right or Wrong, and say what is off. For a pose that is wrong, add a photo of how it should look: the joints are found in the photo and saved with your verdict.

No poses match.

Drag any joint to where it should be. Orange is the left side, teal the right. Your corrected joints are saved with the pose and marked Wrong, so it can be fixed in the app. The figure follows the joints on the website version of this page.
